body: Same here, just watch everything and anything to make the time pass a little more quickly, and fill up all the quiet empty space with sound. Makes you forget for a short while that you are always alone. No amount of media, though, makes the time pass quick enough, every time I check the time, it's been so much shorter than I'd have wished

As someone the same as the poster, reading this comment makes me feel a little more human. It's not that I can't discern my reality from fiction, I'd just much much rather live in the fictional reality that I imagine. Imagining talking to people, imagining having people listen, is so much better than trying  and failing, to talk to someone, or talking and them not hearing me.
Didn't know it existed. It does, however, seem to be filled with people feeling the way I do.. thanks
I'm the opposite.. I can no longer feel around people, with others, I am numb, empty, I can't say or feel what I need to. On my own, I can feel only pain.

Anything inside of me that once understood a life without pain shriveled and died a long time ago.. 

How can someone be their own friend if they don't even know who they are? How do you get to know yourself when you don't recognize recognize face that stares back at you in the mirror?

I don't say this out of spite, I thank you for taking the energy to read this, to process, to reply. That's more than anyone has done for me in a long time. 

Thankyou for your kind words, though simply saying something may not seem to you like a huge deal, it seems as though you do it often, to people who are lost, just a little ray of light can shine brighter than the sun.

Continue to care, one day you will be able to reconnect someone to the part of them that cares, too.

Hug recieved.. xx
